01_plywood_base.note: Countersinks on underside; M4/wood screws heads must finish flush.

03_clear_rear_panel.note: 6mm flat sheet. Do not heat bend; bolted angle brackets join separate top plate.

04_clear_top_cantilever.note: 97mm front-to-back; 91mm projection from rear panel front. Center bore permits EM top access and reference Hall sensing.

05_angle_bracket_left.note: Print on side; 4mm flanges. M4 bolt+washers+nut each flange.

05_angle_bracket_right.note: Print on side; 4mm flanges. M4 bolt+washers+nut each flange.

06_em_cradle.note: 25.6mm bore. Four M3 through-bolts retain cassette; no unknown coil thread used. 10x6mm side lead exit.

07_helper_retainer_cassette.note: Pocket open upward. Helper rests on floor168.1mm and is captive under EM when bolted. Cassette also positively supports coil rim; remove four bolts to change helper.

08_lower_Hall_guard.note: 2mm protective stop; slot travel +/-2.3mm lateral. Board/sensor total envelope <=12x8x2mm sits on top; solder leads exit sides. Sensor not a fitted socket.

09_upper_Hall_carrier.note: Board/sensor retained with nylon ties/adhesive; adjust lateral position in slots and orient sensor sensitive axis vertically. Confirm package before assembly.

10_catch_tray.note: 64x64mm clear cavity, floor1.5mm. Add nonmagnetic foam; screw to base. No enclosure or supply geometry assumed.

REF_electromagnet_25x20.note: Nominal project envelope, not measured supplier drawing; remove references for manufacturing.

REF_helper_19p05x1p5875.note: Candidate DC1 dimensions; sits on pocket floor. 0.3125mm top clearance to EM.

REF_payload_ASSUMED_12p7x6_gap15.note: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Top155mm =>15mm EM face gap. Total moving mass must be10g; this envelope is not an ordered part.

REF_lower_Hall_allowance.note: Package+carrier allowance, not actual sensor package. Must confirm <=2mm total height or lower guard (changes stop clearance).

REF_upper_Hall_allowance.note: Package+carrier allowance, not actual sensor package.
